newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-VENTSPILS TO POOL RESERVOIR CAPACITY.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-VENTSPILS TO POOL RESERVOIR CAPACITY.

text.p: Ventspils oil and oil products transit firms have decided to pool their diesel storage capacity to increase the effeciency of the oil product pipe-line, Ventspils Nafta was quoted in Diena newspaper as saying.
Ventspils Nafta, Naftas parks, Ventbunkers and LatRosTrans were signatories of the agreement, a Ventspils Nafta spokesman was quoted as saying.
A similar protocol is currently being prepared between Ventspils Nafta and Russia's Transnefprodukt.

Transneftprodukt vice-president Sergei Makarov visited Ventspils on Tuesday to discuss the possibility of enhancing the efficiency of oil and oil products, a Ventspils Nafta spokesman was reported as saying.
